Gold.note: Strong central bank buying and safe-haven demand amid rate cut expectations.

Silver.note: Dual tailwinds from precious metal rally and robust industrial solar demand.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and strong electrification demand from AI and EVs.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and renewed global nuclear build-outs.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply from new capacity outpacing slowing EV battery demand.

Nickel.note: Severe Indonesian supply surplus overwhelming sluggish battery-grade demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter treatment charge squeezes supporting prices.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property sector dampening steelmaking demand.

Coal.note: Steady near-term thermal demand offset by long-term energy transition headwinds.

Rare Earths.note: Balanced geopolitical supply risks against currently soft permanent magnet demand.

Manganese.note: Stable steel production requirements offsetting lack of major battery catalysts.

PGM.note: Weak internal combustion engine sales pressuring traditional automotive catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Resilient global agricultural application rates following supply chain normalization.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary smelter capacity in China coupled with strong lightweighting demand.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to bulk and battery metals mitigating single-commodity volatility.
